checkout_completed_evidence.name: checkout_completed_evidence
checkout_completed_evidence.value: "checkout_orders"."state" <> 'completed' or ("checkout_orders"."provider_order_id" is not null and "checkout_orders"."provider_capture_id" is not null and "checkout_orders"."verified_at" is not null and "checkout_orders"."captured_at" is not null)

checkout_capture_observation.name: checkout_capture_observation
checkout_capture_observation.value: "checkout_orders"."capture_status" is null or ("checkout_orders"."capture_status" in ('PENDING','COMPLETED','FAILED','DECLINED') and "checkout_orders"."observed_capture_id" is not null and "checkout_orders"."capture_checked_at" is not null)

checkout_capture_pending_reason.name: checkout_capture_pending_reason
checkout_capture_pending_reason.value: "checkout_orders"."capture_pending_reason" is null or ("checkout_orders"."capture_pending_reason" = 'ECHECK' and "checkout_orders"."capture_status" is not null and "checkout_orders"."capture_status" = 'PENDING')

checkout_capture_identity.name: checkout_capture_identity
checkout_capture_identity.value: "checkout_orders"."observed_capture_id" is null or "checkout_orders"."provider_capture_id" is null or "checkout_orders"."observed_capture_id" = "checkout_orders"."provider_capture_id"

twin_payment_provenance.name: twin_payment_provenance
twin_payment_provenance.value: ("purchase_twins"."origin" = 'sample' and "purchase_twins"."checkout_order_id" is null and "purchase_twins"."paypal_order_id" is null and "purchase_twins"."paypal_capture_id" is null and "purchase_twins"."verified_at" is null and "purchase_twins"."product_snapshot" is null) or ("purchase_twins"."origin" = 'sandbox' and "purchase_twins"."checkout_order_id" is not null and "purchase_twins"."paypal_order_id" is not null and "purchase_twins"."paypal_capture_id" is not null and "purchase_twins"."verified_at" is not null and "purchase_twins"."product_snapshot" is not null)

care_call_bounds.name: care_call_bounds
care_call_bounds.value: "care_model_calls"."call" between 1 and 2 and "care_model_calls"."reserved_micro"=40000 and ("care_model_calls"."actual_micro" is null or "care_model_calls"."actual_micro" between 0 and "care_model_calls"."reserved_micro") and (("care_model_calls"."actual_micro" is null) = ("care_model_calls"."settled_at" is null))

care_request_nonnegative.name: care_request_nonnegative
care_request_nonnegative.value: "care_requests"."reserved_micro" >= 0 and "care_requests"."provider_calls" between 0 and 2 and ("care_requests"."actual_micro" is null or "care_requests"."actual_micro" >= 0)

guardian_price_bounds.name: guardian_price_bounds
guardian_price_bounds.value: "guardian_prices"."old_minor" between 1 and 20000 and "guardian_prices"."new_minor" between 1 and 20000 and "guardian_prices"."currency"='USD'

guardian_refund_completed.name: guardian_refund_completed
guardian_refund_completed.value: "guardian_refunds"."state"<>'completed' or ("guardian_refunds"."refund_id" is not null and "guardian_refunds"."provider_status"='COMPLETED' and "guardian_refunds"."verified_at" is not null)
